description.value: Dageraad Brewing is a small-batch artisan brewery crafting Belgian-inspired beers from a warehouse tasting room steps from Production Way SkyTrain station in Burnaby, named after the Dageraadplaats neighbourhood square in Antwerp. The 50-seat indoor tasting room is complemented by a 50-seat covered, heated patio — a welcoming stop in any weather. Dageraad was awarded 2018 Brewery of the Year by the Canadian Brewing Awards and offers a rotating lineup of Belgian-style ales including saisons, strong goldens, and mixed-culture fermentations.
